items.title: Zutty Singleton and Marge Singleton Interview, 1969-02-08
items.q: He reminded me of Lionel Hatton. He was the same way when he was younger.

ctx.x: Yeah Sell He was a Sell Sell He loved to ride the train That's why He meant there I feel I was still there But I knew I knew I knew I knew I knew They They They They They They They They They They They They They They They Sidney Bache, Alton Nichols, Wilman Boe, Sidney the Paris, all of them. The guys he loved, he wanted to record with. He reminded me of Lionel Hatton. He was the same way when he was younger. He said, wow, he's so much. Any guy, he'd play something he'd like, he'd raise that neck, recorded, to get…
In the recording studio, the first record you made was... The trio, that's right. There was nothing written there, wasn't there?
